description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for user analytics metrics API endpoints. It imports controller functions, sets up route paths with corresponding handlers, and ensures necessary database indexes are initialized on startup.

methods.name: ensureUsersAnalyticsIndexes
methods.description: Initializes database indexes for user analytics, called once when the module is loaded.

methods.name: dailyActive
methods.description: Handles GET request for daily active users over a specified number of days.

methods.name: byDepartment
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve user analytics grouped by department.

methods.name: activeVsInactive
methods.description: Handles GET request comparing active and inactive users within a time window.

methods.name: topActive
methods.description: Handles GET request for the top active users with optional limit and window parameters.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Handles GET request for a summary of user analytics.
